message: Last winter, I remember my neighbor chuckling when I suggested we stock up on a few extra supplies before the big storm hit. Well, when the snow started piling up and the power went out, I might have had a tiny moment of smugness while sipping my hot cocoa next to my trusty stash of snacks. Sometimes, being a tad over-prepared just feels right, don’t you think? What’s your go-to comfort snack for stormy days? ❄️
